newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - July 9.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - July 9.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Wednesday:
* Kuala Lumpur's Composite Index of blue chips ended down 2.76 points or 0.26 percent to 1,057.77 on Tuesday, continuing a decline on foreign fund bearishness.
Second Board index of small-capitalised shares also finished weaker, off 7.20 points or 1.29 percent to 552.73.

* Negative trend could continue as investors seek out more attractive valuations in the region, analysts say. "Malaysia has become the ugly sister in Asia at the moment," said an analyst with a local brokerage firm. "Nobody wants her."
* Wall Street finished at record high, with Dow up 103.81 points to 7,962.31 on optimism over second quarter earnings.
* Ringgit still closely watched as Bank Negara maintains presence to guard against speculative selling. At 1030 GMT on Tuesday, ringgit quoted at 2.5065/75 to a dollar.
* Among stocks in the news, Hospital Pantai says it is calling off issue of four million shares priced at 10 ringgit each and planning instead a four-for-one bonus. Stock was suspended on Tuesday.
* Metal products concern Chin Foh set to list on Second Board with shares offered at 2.80 ringgit.
